## Setup

```{python}
#| label: setup
from pathlib import Path
import sys

PROJECT_ROOT = Path.cwd()
if not (PROJECT_ROOT / "lib").exists() and (PROJECT_ROOT.parent / "lib").exists():
    PROJECT_ROOT = PROJECT_ROOT.parent
if str(PROJECT_ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_ROOT))

BASE_ZIP = Path("/Volumes/KINGSTON/tesis-project/raw/censo2024/Base_manzana_entidad_CPV24.zip")
CARTO_MZ = Path("/Volumes/KINGSTON/tesis-project/raw/censo2024/cartografia_parquet/Cartografia_censo2024_Pais_Manzanas.parquet")
ZONAS777_SHP = Path("/Volumes/KINGSTON/tesis-project/raw/zonas777/Zonas777-04-04-2014/Shape/Zonas777_V07_04_2014.shp")

OUT_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / "02_eda/tmp/censo2024_zona777"
OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

print("BASE_ZIP:", BASE_ZIP)
print("CARTO_MZ:", CARTO_MZ)
print("ZONAS777_SHP:", ZONAS777_SHP)
print("OUT_DIR:", OUT_DIR)
```

## Run join + aggregation (centroid) — bbox vs region filters

```{python}
#| label: run-join-aggregation
from lib.censo2024_zona777 import JoinConfig, run

for mode in ["bbox", "region", "intersects"]:
    print(f"\n--- filter_mode={mode} ---")
    cfg = JoinConfig(
        base_zip=BASE_ZIP,
        base_csv_name="Base_manzana_entidad_CPV24.csv",
        carto_parquet=CARTO_MZ,
        zonas777_shp=ZONAS777_SHP,
        out_dir=OUT_DIR,
        use_centroid=True,
        compute_intersects=True,
        filter_mode=mode,
    )

    df_agg, diag = run(cfg)
    print("Diagnostics:", diag)
    print(df_agg.head())

print("\n--- area-weighted (intersects) ---")
cfg_area = JoinConfig(
    base_zip=BASE_ZIP,
    base_csv_name="Base_manzana_entidad_CPV24.csv",
    carto_parquet=CARTO_MZ,
    zonas777_shp=ZONAS777_SHP,
    out_dir=OUT_DIR,
    use_centroid=False,
    compute_intersects=True,
    filter_mode="intersects",
    area_weighted=True,
)
df_agg_area, diag_area = run(cfg_area)
print("Diagnostics:", diag_area)
print(df_agg_area.head())
```

## Quick checks

```{python}
#| label: quick-checks
import pandas as pd

for mode in ["bbox", "region", "intersects", "intersects_area"]:
    parquet_path = OUT_DIR / f"censo2024_zona777_agg_{mode}.parquet"
    df = pd.read_parquet(parquet_path)
    print(f"{mode} rows:", len(df), "cols:", df.columns[:10].tolist())

    # basic sanity: shares in [0,1]
    share_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c.startswith("share_")]
    if share_cols:
        print(df[share_cols].describe())
```

**Nota sobre `share_*` > 1**  
Algunos `share_*` pueden superar 1 porque el numerador no siempre es un subconjunto estricto del denominador.  
Ejemplos: `share_internet`, `share_serv_tel_movil`, `share_serv_compu` cuentan **servicios/dispositivos**, y un hogar puede tener múltiples.  
En área‑weighted también puede aparecer >1 por redondeos y denominadores muy pequeños.

## Variables disponibles en el parquet final

```{python}
#| label: final-vars-inventory
import pandas as pd

FINAL_PATH = OUT_DIR / "censo2024_zona777_agg_final.parquet"
if not FINAL_PATH.exists():
    # Fallback razonable si aún no se ha copiado/renombrado el final
    FINAL_PATH = OUT_DIR / "censo2024_zona777_agg_intersects_area.parquet"

df_final = pd.read_parquet(FINAL_PATH)
all_cols = df_final.columns.tolist()

count_cols = [c for c in all_cols if c.startswith("n_")]
mean_cols = [c for c in all_cols if c.startswith("prom_")]
share_cols = [c for c in all_cols if c.startswith("share_")]
other_cols = [c for c in all_cols if c not in (["ZONA777"] + count_cols + mean_cols + share_cols)]

print("Parquet final:", FINAL_PATH)
print("N filas (zonas):", len(df_final))
print("N columnas:", len(all_cols))

inventory = pd.DataFrame({
    "grupo": (
        ["id"] * 1
        + ["count"] * len(count_cols)
        + ["mean"] * len(mean_cols)
        + ["share"] * len(share_cols)
        + ["other"] * len(other_cols)
    ),
    "variable": (
        ["ZONA777"]
        + count_cols
        + mean_cols
        + share_cols
        + other_cols
    ),
})

display(inventory)
```
